title: Apples up here, and now wine
text: Tehachapi sits close to 4,000 feet above sea level, up between the San Joaquin Valley and the Mojave Desert. The town has long been farming country, growing apples, peaches, grain, vegetables and hay year round. Wine is the newer crop, and the Tehachapi Mountains were approved as an official American wine-growing area in 2020.
